scope: macOS-style Wi-Fi and battery menus, shared with Control Center, using edition-specific glass and existing native network/power actions.

environment.real_plasmashell_popups: Both native applets activated via KGlobalAccel; active AppletPopup windows recorded in live-menu-final.log. Hardware unavailable in VM; populated lists and battery percentage in preview use deterministic fixtures.

comparison.scale: 2 physical pixels per logical pixel, aligned top-left with no screenshot rescaling; 50/50 opacity overlay
differences: Different fixture text, percentage and wallpaper; Wi-Fi reference has an extra Personal Hotspot section.
Battery reference includes app energy-usage information that the Linux menu does not fabricate.
The existing edition materials remain distinct; this is not a pixel-identical claim.

focused_checks.claims: Native imports, native wireless enable/disable, hardware blocking, saved/discovered network grouping, connect/disconnect/add activation arguments, busy state, scan gating, battery source state, real pointer and keyboard energy-profile selection, popup rendering.

focused_checks.result: only Wi-Fi, battery, Control Center and dependent notification payload hashes changed

coverage_limits: Single representative KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 / Qt 6.11.1 Wayland VM. Native code, shaders, SDK APIs and installer lifecycle did not change.
Physical Wi-Fi connections and real battery hardware were not exercised; native action contracts used deterministic hardware models.

Actual project automatic dusk/dawn crossings were observed with persistent menus, Qt/Kvantum and GTK 3/4 windows. Native KDE appearance changes used plasma-apply-colorscheme; native sunrise/sunset scheduler configuration was not changed.
Historical README/installer galleries retain their original provenance; only the user-approved focused preview is added.
Full distro CI remains asynchronous; no passing status is claimed for uncompleted jobs.
